# nemo8 speed: GPU path vs host CPU (generated by tools/nemo8_bench.py)

Median of 3 warm runs. GPU = kit plan (optimized front end) on a resident exec_server2 (weights loaded once). CPU = host tasr_cli_a72, greedy decode without the language model (same decoder as the GPU path). GPU CPU seconds = user+sys of the server process per run. CPU seconds = user+sys of the process (multi-threaded).
